name: INDI+P cloud data refresh

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '*/30 * * * *'
      timezone: 'Asia/Seoul'
    - cron: '17 */3 * * *'
      timezone: 'Asia/Seoul'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write

concurrency:
  group: indip-cloud-data-refresh
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  refresh:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      INDIP_SKIP_FUNCTIONS_BOOTSTRAP: "1"
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.13'
      - name: Refresh Dtryx schedule
        if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.event.schedule == '*/30 * * * *'
        run: python scripts/sync_dtryx.py
      - name: Refresh cinema news
        if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.event.schedule == '17 */3 * * *'
        run: |
          python scripts/sync_news.py
          python scripts/build_news_weekly.py
      - name: Validate JSON
        shell: python
        run: |
          import json, pathlib
          for name in ("live.json","movies.json","programs.json","news-weekly.json"):
              p=pathlib.Path("data")/name
              if p.exists():
                  json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
                  print("OK",p)
      - name: Commit refreshed data
        shell: bash
        run: |
          git config user.name "INDI+P Auto Data"
          git config user.email "indip-auto@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add data/live.json data/movies.json data/programs.json data/news-raw.json data/news-weekly.json
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "No data changes"
            exit 0
          fi
          git commit -m "data: automatic cinema/news refresh"
          for n in 1 2 3 4; do
            git pull --rebase origin main && git push origin HEAD:main && exit 0
            git rebase --abort || true
            sleep $((n*2))
          done
          exit 1
